exports.p13d.json: model: the chosen model in the fields of gam_refit's fit record, for python3 p13c.py --model p13d
exports.p13d_model_set.npz: members and member_tables: the S3 set (centered tables in the model's table order, idx maps them to the union) for P14's rule S4. names, theta, tables and ranks: every fit

model.background: the level's p_pop negatives, full-fit weights
model.name: without both

protocol.model: gam_refit's chosen configuration at P13c's level, arm and penalty weight

rules.S1: the bounded p_pop-B at lambda replaces the free model when the lower end of the interval of (bounded - free) lies above -SESOI
rules.S2: in the family that S1 keeps, a fit more than SESOI above the start with the interval above 0 is eligible (R1 of gam_refit). With an eligible fit, gam_audit.one_se_choice() over the start and the eligible fits, the strongest penalty first and at equal lambda the model's arm first (R2 of gam_refit). Otherwise the start
rules.S3: every fit of P13c and P13d within SESOI of the best
rules.S4: a reason that passes D1 of P13c is shown only when it is positive under every S3 member and in the top 3 of at least 80% of them

protocol.source: the docstring of p13d.py, and its code check

s4.d1_source: D1 of P13c, for the free model (p_pop-B at lambda)
